17181.second_source: https://www.smartrecruiters.com/UnionCountyGovernment/81089202-emt-paramedic (county job post: ALS service in Jonesboro handling emergency calls)

services.name: Jasper County Ambulance Service
services.evidence: Jasper County Ambulance service provides emergency medical care throughout the county. Emergencies: 911

services.name: Lawrence County Ambulance Service
services.evidence: Lawrence County Ambulance Service provides both emergency and non-emergency ambulance services to residents of Lawrence County, Illinois.

services.name: RuralMed
services.evidence: The current Effingham County contracted EMS provider is RuralMed.

17049.page_note: RuralMed is named as the contractor in an October 2026 county agenda. Not yet confirmed: its contract area, and whether other providers serve the county.

services.name: West Frankfort Fire Department
services.evidence: exclusive County ambulance-service franchise for Franklin County, excluding Denning Township and Frankfort Township, where West Frankfort Fire Department presently provides primary emergency ambulance service. ... City of Benton Fire Department as a secondary provider of ambulance services at the basic life support level. (RFP p.3-4)

17055.page_note: The county put its ambulance franchise out for bid on October 20, 2026, and the bid documents do not name the current franchisee.

services.name: Menard County EMS
services.evidence: Menard County EMS provides 24/7 Advanced Life Support Emergency Transport. In the event of a medical emergency, please dial 9-1-1.

17129.page_note: Menard County EMS is likely the sole county provider, but its page does not state a coverage area.

services.name: Pike County Ambulance Service
services.evidence: Pike County Ambulance Service operates as a department of Pike County, Illinois Government... Emergency Medical Services; Enhanced 911 EMS Communications Center

17149.page_note: Pike County Ambulance Service is likely the sole county provider, but its page does not state a coverage area.

services.name: Advanced Medical Transport (AMT)
services.evidence: the City of Peoria and Advanced Medical Transport finalized a pact that extends the city's ambulance services for at least five years beyond the current contract.

17143.page_note: Advanced Medical Transport serves Peoria. Not yet confirmed: the rest of Peoria County.

services.name: Carle Arrow Ambulance
services.area: Cities of Champaign (franchise from 2025-11-15) and Urbana
services.evidence: Carle Arrow Ambulance is now Champaign's sole emergency medical services provider (5-year franchise; AMT ended Champaign service Nov. 15, 2025; Arrow already serves Urbana)

17019.page_note: Carle Arrow Ambulance serves Champaign city. Not yet confirmed: rural Champaign County.

services.name: America Ambulance, LifeStar Ambulance, MedicsFirst
services.evidence: Springfield code restricts hospital transports to up to three state-licensed private organizations, currently America Ambulance, LifeStar Ambulance and MedicsFirst; firefighters are paramedic-certified but can't transport (search summary; article date not confirmed)

services.name: Springfield Fire Department
services.evidence: firefighters... can't transport them to a hospital

17167.page_note: Springfield Fire Department and the ambulance companies America Ambulance, LifeStar and MedicsFirst operate in the county. Not yet confirmed: how current those arrangements are, and who serves the rest of Sangamon County.

services.name: Chicago Fire Department
services.evidence: the Chicago Fire Department is in charge of both firefighters and paramedics... 75 ambulances (private ambulances mostly do hospital-to-hospital transports)

17031.page_note: Chicago Fire Department serves the city. Suburban Cook County has about 120 municipal fire departments and fire protection districts, many with private contract ambulances, and is not covered here.
